The '''CZX-4 blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

The [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] [[De'Hesta Bretu]] used two CZX-4 blaster pistols during the [[raid on Kessan's Landing]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:CoC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=daily|Chain of Command|Ord Mantell}}</ref>
